notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Version v1.0.3 of NightKnight is now live!

In this update, we focused on three main goals -
1. Improving the overall performance of the game on both HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Expect a much smoother experience while playing from now on. 
2. We've now added the use of in-game coins! With them, you can purchase traps immediately instead of waiting until they respawn at the end of each week. This will also be used as our ground base for future updates that will involve a lot more options for purchasing. We'll elaborate more on that in the future :)
For now, you can also see the top richest players in our newly added "Gold Diggers" global leaderboard!
3. As always, fixing various bugs. 

Release notes -
[NK-387] - Players can reset position and change height/rotation
[NK-396] - Skeleton King now spawns more types of creeps
[NK-487] - Added additional fire positions for Archers in front of the gate
[NK-503] - Traps can be respawned by using coins
[NK-509] - Storyteller goes away when he is being shot
[NK-540] - Applied new main font
[NK-558] - Enable position move for all possible tower stations
[NK-547] - Implemented save/load for coins
[NK-548] - Fixed bow's highlight causing major lags
[NK-535] - Fixed Leaderboard not showing after reset
[NK-545] - Fixed Leaderboard now showing data when the game ends
[NK-534] - Fixed creeps agent when attacking

Join our Discord to chat with us directly! >> https://discordapp.com/invite/fpHb4wZ

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We're working on adding new features and fixing various bugs. 
The main new feature in this update is the addition of the Global Leaderboard!
You asked for it, we delivered. Show us what you got!

Join our Discord and let us know what you think ->
https://discordapp.com/invite/fpHb4wZ

Release Notes -
[NK-534] - Global Leaderboard 
[NK-531] – Players can adjust position with controllers (up/down + rotation) 
[NK-391] - Oculus and Vive controllers mapping
[NK-529] – Waves Balance
[NK-520] - Deactivated traps during end game cut scene
[NK-448] - Fixed King's praying animation position
[NK-510] – Fixed Trap’s timer display
[NK-513] - Straighten the archers on their first shot
[NK-516] – Fixed creeps stuck after being freeze
[NK-522] - Disabled traps during unlock sequence
[NK-525] - Adjusted Explosive bow damage 
[NK-528] – Fixed refiling HP after game lost

New updates are coming soon!
